title: TO LAUGH IS TO BE LISTENING.

do_not_reinvent.jester: /data/pi-sort-personal.json — the jester lives in the cracks. not a fifth kingdom.

law: to laugh IS to be listening
not: laugh after you listened. not a prize for hearing. the laugh IS the listen made visible.

why.you_cannot: laugh with the room if the rhythm did not go through
why.catch: a forced laugh is a catch — fist, no hear
why.react: a real laugh is the body answering. same family as dance. signal.
why.beacon: the laugh is already a mark that we HEARD. sometimes we do not need a second beacon.

berry_at_the_fire: to laugh IS to be listening. not after. the laugh is the listen you can see. a fake laugh is a catch. a real one is the through.
next: if someone laughs and the room did not pass, it is costume. if they heard and never laugh or dance, the coil never popped — not a crime, just still L.
